Bug_Details:
This call doesn't make sense. For any collection c, calling c.containsAll(c) should
always be true, and c.retainAll(c) should have no effect.
     c c.containsAll(c) c.retainAll(c)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is a vacuous call to the retainAll method of the List interface. This method retains only the elements in this list that are contained in the specified collection. In this case, the collection is the list itself, so calling retainAll with the same list has no effect.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of BuggyCollection class with a list of integers. The showBug method contains the buggy line of code 'inputList.retainAll(inputList);' which is a vacuous call to the retainAll method. This line doesn't have any effect as it retains only the elements in the list that are contained in the specified collection and in this case, the collection is the same list.
